ModMetaData.name: Deep Colony
ModMetaData.author: azraelgodking
ModMetaData.description:
Your colonists are more than their stats. Deep Colony adds five interlocking systems that give each colonist a real identity — and make your colony feel like it has a living history.
🌳 PERK TREES As colonists hit skill levels 5 and 15, they earn perk points you can spend on permanent passive bonuses — better aim, faster surgery, richer harvests. Every skill has its own two-node tree.
🧠 TRAUMA & THERAPY Hostile downs, violent loss of close companions, captivity, and mass-casualty raids can leave lasting psychological trauma that fades over weeks. Doctors can counsel the wounded mind (or right-click Counsel), and casual therapy chats still help.
🎓 APPRENTICESHIP Pair a veteran with a rookie via right-click (mentor must lead by 3+ skill levels). Apprentices earn bonus XP near their mentor; the Mentoring work type runs active teaching sessions.
👶 GENERATIONAL COLONIES Children and recruits with colonist parents can inherit traits and passions. Build long enough and you'll see echoes of your founders.
🏛️ LIVING FACTION REPUTATION Raids and trade nudge goodwill. Strong friendships and deep enmities slowly drift over time without constant contact.
Requires Harmony.
